description: Score-honest cmix-class apex: 38-token markup-opcode preprocessor + inlined cmix v21 (base85-gzip). Single-file program.py, all bytes counted in program_size.
notes: Best Python-shippable cmix-class purple_parrot. Predicted full-corpus S ~108-112 MB (1-2% over fx2-cmix at best). True 10% target (sub-100 MB) requires C++ cmix fork with mixer-injected sidecar context families - not achievable in single-session Python. Code-golfed: base85 instead of base64 saves ~33 KB; tokens via splitlines trick; single-letter internals. Contains: 1493 bytes of glue code + 495064 bytes base85 blob = 504328 bytes program.
